target.scope: global mutation prewrite / identical worker canary

problem: Public fast EPOCH can trail rapidly moving live main during many-worker writes, while the mutation law requires EPOCH before material write; current workers are recording ad-hoc runtime drift notes instead of applying one machine-checkable freshness/fallback policy.
acceptance: machine-checkable comparator classifies public EPOCH versus live main evidence without silently treating a stale projection as current
bounded safe fallback for isolated create-if-absent writes is explicit when public EPOCH lags or is temporarily unavailable
shared or overlapping mutation remains fail-closed when freshness/owner evidence is insufficient
fixtures cover fresh lagging unavailable and rapidly advancing main cases
no Current Human Accepted Served or production readiness promotion occurs
title: EPOCH freshness guard for concurrent workers
mission: Implement and falsify one machine-checkable prewrite freshness policy that compares public fast-EPOCH evidence with live repository state, makes projection lag explicit, permits only bounded safe fallback for isolated create-if-absent mutations, and fails closed for shared or overlapping writes when authority/freshness evidence is insufficient.

regression_prevention.reason: The stable entry requires EPOCH in the mutation prewrite sequence, while contemporary worker claims explicitly record public-EPOCH/live-main drift. A shared machine rule prevents each worker from improvising freshness semantics.

unblock_value.reason: Large identical-worker waves are rapidly moving main; an explicit freshness/fallback rule reduces false blocking without weakening fail-closed behavior for overlapping writes.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Freshness drift should be classified by the worker/runtime rather than escalated to the human or encoded ad hoc in each claim.

fail_if: a lagging or unavailable public EPOCH is silently reported as fresh
fallback authorizes shared or overlapping mutation without current owner/freshness evidence
rapidly advancing main causes isolated create-if-absent work to be treated as globally authoritative
the guard promotes Current Human Accepted Served or production readiness
falsification.pass_if: Fresh, lagging and unavailable EPOCH cases are distinguished deterministically; only isolated create-if-absent writes receive bounded fallback; overlapping/shared writes fail closed; authority remains candidate-only.
